description: This file contains unit tests for URL normalization functions, testing various URL components such as scheme, authority, port, escaping, high-bit characters, UTF-8, username and password, URL length, dots in the path, and URL equivalence. It uses an external URL normalization function and a test framework with assertions.

methods.name: void check_url_normalizable(const char * url,unsigned int normalizable)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is considered normalizable based on the normalization function output.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url(const char * url,const char * expect)
methods.description: Asserts that a URL normalizes to an expected value.

methods.name: void compare_normalized_urls(const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
methods.description: Checks if two URLs normalize to the same or different values.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url_length(const char * url,size_t len)
methods.description: Verifies the length of the normalized URL matches expected length.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__scheme(void)
methods.description: Unit test for testing URL scheme normalization and validity.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__authority(void)
methods.description: Unit test for authority component normalization, including user info and host.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port(void)
methods.description: Unit test for port number normalization and validation.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port_normalization(void)
methods.description: Checks that URLs with different port notation normalize to consistent forms.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__general_escape(void)
methods.description: Tests URL normalization with escape sequences in URL components.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__high_bit(void)
methods.description: Verifies normalization of URLs containing high-bit (non-ASCII) characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__utf8_escape(void)
methods.description: Tests encoding of UTF-8 characters into URL escape sequences.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__username_pass(void)
methods.description: Checks normalization involving user and password components.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__length(void)
methods.description: Verifies the length of the normalized URL matches expected.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__dots(void)
methods.description: Tests normalization of URLs containing dot segments for path.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__equivalents(void)
methods.description: Checks normalization equivalence between URLs with minor differences.

ctags.name: check_url_normalizable
ctags.pattern: /^static void check_url_normalizable(const char *url, unsigned int normalizable)$/

ctags.name: compare_normalized_urls
ctags.signature: (const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
